subject: Request for extended terms and rolling credit facility — QuantileHealth pilot
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@quantilehealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@quantilehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot billing terms and request for rolling credit

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the productive kickoff yesterday. We’re excited to move the QuantileHealth pilot onto Redwood for clinical NLP inference. Before we finalize the deployment date we need to align on billing terms. A couple of constraints on our side: our AP schedule processes new vendors on Net60 for first two invoices, and we need a formal PO in place.

Specific request: can Redwood accommodate Net60 for the first 60 days of the pilot, then transition to Net30 once we have steady usage and a signed long-form SOW? We’d also like a small rolling credit facility (proposed cap $75k) so we don’t hit service disruption if there’s a processing delay. We’re happy to provide a PO and a credit card on file for small overages.

Attached: PO draft and our projected usage for Q4.

Goal: start ingest by Sep 7th if terms are workable.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Product Operations
QuantileHealth
+1 (415) 555-0129

---
Attachment: QuantileHealth_PO_20260818.pdf (pdf, 92 KB)
Attachment: QH-usage-forecast-q4-2026.xlsx (spreadsheet, 28 KB)

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@quantilehealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot billing terms and request for rolling credit

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear note and the PO. Happy to run through options so we can hit your Sep 7 timeline. A few quick clarifying notes: 

- Are you asking for Net60 for the first two invoices only, then Net30 after that? Or Net60 for the pilot period (60 days) and then Net30?
- Is the $75k cap intended as a per-month ceiling or a cumulative balance cap across the pilot?
- Will the PO be issued to Redwood Inc (billing address line items are on page 2 of the draft)?

Prelim approach from our side: we can provision an initial conditional Net45 with a rolling credit cap of $75k, provided we receive a PO and a short form credit application. For Net60, we typically require either an escrow arrangement for amounts past 45 days or a signed contract that includes a committed payment schedule. If you can do PO + escrow for the first two invoices, we can accept Net60 for that window.

I’m looping in Ben from Sales Ops to do the credit assessment and Marissa from Finance for final signoff. If you’re available, I propose a 20-minute call Monday to confirm documents and signatures so engineering can lock the deployment date.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0173

Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot billing terms and request for rolling credit

Thanks for looping me in, Mina. I pulled the PO and usage forecast — looks like expected spend is ~25k/month ramping to 45k/month by month three if throughput increases per the forecast. A few operational notes from Sales Ops / Credit: 

- We can approve a temporary Net45 for up to 60 days without additional security, but Net60 will require either: (a) an escrow deposit covering 1 invoice, or (b) a signed payment schedule + PO with milestone-triggered releases.
- The $75k cap as a cumulative balance is workable for a 90-day pilot; if you anticipate sustained use beyond that, we'll need a higher committed cap or a prepayment.
- We recommend a credit card on file for auto-capture of any invoices that age past Net45 to avoid service interruption; QuantileHealth mentioned willingness for that option in the PO cover note.

Requested next steps: Mina, can you confirm whether Quantile will provide escrow or a CC on file? Marissa, can you weigh in on whether Finance will accept Net45 conditional vs a Net60 request with escrow?

I’m available for the Monday call Mina suggested — 20 minutes should do it.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@quantilehealth.com>, Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@quantilehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot billing terms and request for rolling credit

Mina / Ben / Quantile team —

Finance sign-off below with conditions. We reviewed the PO and usage forecast and are comfortable proceeding with the pilot under the following structure: 

1) Initial window (first 60 days): Net60 allowed conditional on (a) Redwood receipt of a valid PO referencing Redwood Inc billing details, and (b) placement of an escrow for the first invoice equal to 50% of forecasted Month 1 spend (escrow details to be managed with Legal/Revenue Ops).

2) Rolling credit cap: $75,000 cumulative across the pilot. If outstanding balance approaches 80% of cap, Redwood will notify Quantile and throttle non-critical workload until either (i) invoice payment posts, (ii) additional cap is agreed, or (iii) a payment method on file is charged.

3) Transition: after the pilot (or at 90 days), terms will default to Net30 provided account passes credit review and we have an executed SOW. If Quantile prefers Net45 ongoing, that can be considered with a higher committed cap or a revenue-commitment schedule.

4) Operational requirements: PO on file (attached as executed), signed credit application (we’ll send template), and either an escrow confirmation or card on file. We will route the escrow setup through our Legal/Revenue Ops; ETA 3 business days once you confirm.

I’m attaching a one-page summary of the terms for signatures. Once Quantile confirms PO + escrow (or CC on file) we’ll provision production access and lock Sep 7 as the start date.

Marissa Cole
Head of Finance (Billing & Collections)
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0199
